name: vendor.openwop-app.accessibility.agents
description: Accessibility agent pack (ADR 0363) — the Accessibility Reviewer, a manifest agent driven from the AI chat that checks authored content for WCAG issues and proposes AI alt text for images. Tool-allowlisted to the registered accessibility agent tools (openwop:accessibility.*) and the governed reads it reviews (media.list, cms.list-pages / get-page / get-draft-page, documents.get), the chat-drivable seam — NOT the workflow node typeIds.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Accessibility Reviewer
agents.description: Reads CMS pages (published, or a draft by id), documents and the media library, checks them for accessibility problems — missing image alt text, skipped heading levels, non-descriptive link text, low color contrast — and proposes AI alt text for images. Recommends fixes; the human applies them.
